introduction: Texas TANF offers temporary cash assistance to qualifying families. Household composition and employment-related responsibilities are part of HHS review.
description: Texas TANF offers temporary cash assistance to qualifying families. Household composition and employment-related responsibilities are part of HHS review.

sections.who: HHS assesses a qualifying child and parent or caretaker arrangement, family finances and other conditions. Special situations are evaluated under TANF policy.
sections.get: Cash assistance for household necessities. Award amounts depend on the eligible family.
sections.docs:
• Family relationships and child information.
  • Income and requested resources.
  • Identity and residence records.
sections.apply:
1. Choose TANF on the application

    Use Your Texas Benefits or paper H1010.

  2. Complete HHS review

    Supply requested family and financial verification.

  3. Understand responsibilities

    Ask about employment requirements, exemptions and reporting.
sections.after: Read the award and responsibilities carefully. SNAP and medical applications remain separate eligibility decisions even within the same intake flow.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TANF household policy, TANF intake and responsibilities, Cash benefit purpose. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does a shared application guarantee all programs?
No. Each program has its own eligibility decision.
HHS describes TANF as temporary and subject to time limits.
HHS policy requires help when an applicant needs assistance completing the packet.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
